---
title: "Rotation anatomy"
description: "Keep a rotation package small, ordered, and testable."
---

Every package has three responsibilities:

| File | Responsibility |
| --- | --- |
| `spells.lua` | Create and populate spell objects. |
| `gui.lua` | Define category controls and persisted options. |
| `rotation.lua` | Read the spellbook, organize priority helpers, and register one routine. |

Keep references local to each file. Shared state belongs in your package namespace, not in `_G`. A routine callback should return after a successful action so lower-priority actions do not run in the same tick.
